description: This file is a Bash script that contains test cases for rebase operations in a Git repository. It includes setup commands, various rebase scenarios, and expected behaviors for different options and configurations, primarily testing the 'git rebase' command with different parameters and edge cases.

methods.name: test_run_rebase
methods.description: A reusable function defined multiple times to test different rebase scenarios with various options, verifying the correctness of rebase behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function to assert that a given test scenario succeeds.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: A function to assert that a given test scenario is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: A comparison function to verify that two revisions/commits are identical.

methods.name: test_linear_range
methods.description: A function to check if the commits in a range are linearly ordered.

methods.name: reset_rebase
methods.description: A function to reset the repository state before running a rebase test.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Function to create a new commit with a specified message or configuration.

methods.name: revert
methods.description: Function to create a reverted commit.

methods.name: make_empty
methods.description: Function to create an empty commit.
